boundaries: No new model inference is permitted.
No training-selected pair may be changed.
No layer-gap profile may be changed.
Held-out prompt data may only be used after each split's selection is fixed.
No token-label permutation is needed for this control because the null question concerns layer-pair selection conditional on gap.
This protocol is frozen before any gap-matched result is calculated.
The validated LOPO recurrence result remains scientifically valid regardless of this control's outcome.

gap_matched_baseline.matching_rule: Each random comparison set must contain exactly the same number of pairs at every gap as the frozen selected top-50 set for that LOPO split.
gap_matched_baseline.reason_selected_pairs_remain_eligible: The null represents arbitrary topology conditional only on the exact gap profile; allowing selected pairs makes the test conservative and avoids constructing a baseline from pairs defined as nonselected.
gap_matched_baseline.sampling: uniform without replacement within each layer-gap stratum

interpretation.if_primary_fails: The existing held-out recurrence result remains valid, but its topological selection advantage is not shown to exceed generic layer-distance effects.
interpretation.if_primary_passes: Training-prompt topology selection contains held-out predictive information beyond generic layer-distance decay.
interpretation.stronger_claim_requires: the preregistered primary endpoint; secondary metrics cannot substitute for a failed primary endpoint

primary_endpoint.alternative: global randomized mean enrichment >= observed global mean enrichment
primary_endpoint.global_randomization: For each of 10000 global draws, independently draw one exact-gap-matched 50-pair set for each held-out split, compute each matched mean minus that split's deterministic gap baseline, then average the eight values.
primary_endpoint.observed_statistic: mean gap-adjusted enrichment across all eight held-out prompts

purpose: Test whether training-selected layer-pair topology predicts held-out recurrence beyond the generic effect of layer distance.

robustness_endpoints.multiple_testing: report Holm-Bonferroni adjusted per-split p-values across all eight splits
robustness_endpoints.per_split_randomization: report one-sided 10000-draw empirical p-value for each split
robustness_endpoints.positive_split_requirement: at least 7 of 8 split gap-adjusted enrichments > 0
robustness_endpoints.strong_all_prompt_criterion: descriptive stronger criterion only: 8/8 positive enrichments and all eight Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05

scientific_context.prior_supported_claim: Prompt-generalizing same-token recurrence exists in training-selected short-range layer topology.
scientific_context.prior_unsupported_claim: The training-selected ranking carries predictive information beyond generic layer-gap effects.

selection.method: reuse the exact frozen top-50 training-selected layer pairs from the validated LOPO experiment

split_statistic.alternative: random matched mean >= observed selected mean
split_statistic.deterministic_gap_baseline: weighted mean of held-out within-gap means using the selected set's exact gap counts
split_statistic.gap_adjusted_enrichment: observed selected mean minus deterministic gap baseline
split_statistic.heldout_values: same-token delta for each of the 630 layer pairs on the untouched held-out prompt
split_statistic.observed: mean held-out delta of the frozen training-selected top-50 pairs
split_statistic.randomization_statistic: mean held-out delta of one random gap-matched 50-pair set
